name: EvidenceAttribute
title: Evidence attributes
description: Observation.component codes that carry the trust metadata with the data.

concept.definition: A-D grade from seven explainable signals.
Sum of points behind the grade.
Position of the record in the evidence graph.
Number of independent reports by other observers that agree.

text.div: Evidence attributes: evidence-grade (Evidence grade), evidence-score (Evidence score (0-100)), trust-level (Trust level), independent-corroborations (Independent corroborations), permitted-use (Permitted use)
